recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs
recipes.instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a pan over medium-low heat. Pour in eggs, stir gently until set.

recipes.name: Fried Rice
recipes.instructions: Heat oil, fry garlic and onion. Add cold rice, stir-fry. Push rice aside, scramble egg. Mix, add soy sauce.

recipes.name: Omelette
recipes.instructions: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter, pour eggs. When set, add cheese, fold.

recipes.name: Pasta Aglio e Olio
recipes.instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté sliced garlic in olive oil with chili flakes. Toss pasta in oil, garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Tomato Soup
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add chopped tomatoes, simmer 20 min. Blend, add basil, season.

recipes.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.instructions: Butter bread outsides. Place cheese between slices. Grill in a pan until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: French Toast
recipes.instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon. Dip bread, fry in butter until golden on both sides.

recipes.name: Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Mix dry and wet ingredients. Cook on a greased griddle until bubbles form, flip.

recipes.name: Garlic Bread
recipes.instructions: Mix minced garlic, butter, and parsley. Spread on bread. Bake at 180C until golden.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
recipes.instructions: Make croutons from bread. Whisk egg yolk, lemon, garlic, olive oil for dressing. Toss with lettuce and parmesan.

recipes.name: Mashed Potatoes
recipes.instructions: Boil potatoes until tender. Mash with butter and milk. Season.

recipes.name: Potato Soup
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter. Add diced potatoes and water. Simmer until soft. Add milk, blend partially, season.

recipes.name: Roasted Potatoes
recipes.instructions: Toss potato chunks with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, pepper. Roast at 200C for 35 min.

recipes.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.instructions: Slice chicken, stir-fry in oil. Add garlic, ginger, onion, bell pepper. Season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Soup
recipes.instructions: Simmer chicken with vegetables for 45 min. Shred chicken, return to pot, season.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add curry powder, chicken, tomato. Simmer in coconut milk 20 min.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
recipes.instructions: Brown beef with onion, garlic, cumin. Serve in tortillas with cheese, lettuce, tomato.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Brown beef, add tomatoes and oregano. Simmer 30 min. Serve over pasta.

recipes.name: Chili Con Carne
recipes.instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add beans, tomatoes, cumin, chili powder. Simmer 30 min.

recipes.name: Burrito Bowl
recipes.instructions: Cook rice. Assemble bowls with beans, chicken, tomato, cheese, lettuce, avocado. Squeeze lime.

recipes.name: Quesadilla
recipes.instructions: Place cheese, chicken, onion, pepper on tortilla. Fold, grill until cheese melts.

recipes.name: Fajitas
recipes.instructions: Slice and stir-fry chicken, peppers, onion with garlic and cumin. Serve with tortillas and lime.

recipes.name: Vegetable Stir-Fry
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry vegetables in oil with garlic and ginger. Add soy sauce, toss.

recipes.name: Vegetable Soup
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion, garlic. Add chopped vegetables and water. Simmer 30 min, season.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.instructions: Slice tomato and mozzarella. Arrange with basil. Drizzle olive oil, season.

recipes.name: Bruschetta
recipes.instructions: Toast bread. Top with diced tomato, garlic, basil, olive oil, salt.

recipes.name: Guacamole
recipes.instructions: Mash avocado. Mix with diced onion, tomato, garlic, lime juice, salt.

recipes.name: Salsa
recipes.instructions: Dice tomato, onion, garlic. Mix with lime juice, cilantro, salt.

recipes.name: Hummus
recipes.instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon, garlic, olive oil, salt until smooth.

recipes.name: Falafel
recipes.instructions: Blend chickpeas with onion, garlic, spices. Form patties, deep-fry.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, pepper. Add tomatoes, spices, simmer. Crack eggs on top, cover until set.

recipes.name: Banana Bread
recipes.instructions: Mash bananas. Mix with melted butter, sugar, egg. Fold in dry ingredients. Bake at 175C for 50 min.

recipes.name: Apple Crumble
recipes.instructions: Slice apples into dish. Mix flour, butter, sugar, cinnamon for topping. Sprinkle, bake at 180C 30 min.

recipes.name: Smoothie
recipes.instructions: Blend banana, milk, yogurt, honey until smooth.

recipes.name: Yogurt Parfait
recipes.instructions: Layer yogurt, oats, berries, drizzle honey.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats
recipes.instructions: Mix oats, milk, honey. Refrigerate overnight. Top with banana.

recipes.name: Porridge
recipes.instructions: Simmer oats in milk. Sweeten with honey, add cinnamon and salt.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.instructions: Stir-fry onion, add rice, make well and scramble egg, add peas, season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad
recipes.instructions: Mix tuna with mayo, diced celery, onion, lemon juice. Season.

recipes.name: BLT Sandwich
recipes.instructions: Cook bacon. Toast bread, spread mayo. Layer bacon, lettuce, tomato.

recipes.name: Bacon and Eggs
recipes.instructions: Fry bacon until crisp. Fry eggs in bacon fat. Season.

recipes.name: Mac and Cheese
recipes.instructions: Cook pasta. Make roux with butter and flour, add milk, then cheese. Toss with pasta.

recipes.name: Pizza Dough
recipes.instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt, sugar, oil, water. Knead, rise 1 hr, shape.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.instructions: Make dough, top with tomato, mozzarella, basil, olive oil. Bake at maximum heat 10 min.

recipes.name: Risotto
recipes.instructions: Sauté onion, garlic. Toast rice, add wine. Gradually add stock. Finish with butter and parmesan.

recipes.name: Gazpacho
recipes.instructions: Blend tomato, cucumber, pepper, onion, garlic with olive oil and vinegar. Chill, serve cold.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
recipes.instructions: Chop vegetables, toss with olives and feta. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano.

recipes.name: Coleslaw
recipes.instructions: Shred cabbage and carrot. Mix with mayo, vinegar, sugar, seasonings.

recipes.name: Pasta Pesto
recipes.instructions: Blend basil, garlic, pine nuts, parmesan, olive oil. Toss with cooked pasta.

recipes.name: Meatballs
recipes.instructions: Mix beef, egg, soaked bread, onion, garlic. Form balls, bake or fry.

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
recipes.instructions: Cook beef with vegetables, thicken with flour. Top with mashed potatoes, bake 30 min.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos
recipes.instructions: Season and grill fish. Serve in tortillas with cabbage slaw, lime, garlic mayo.

recipes.name: Salmon with Rice
recipes.instructions: Cook rice. Pan-sear salmon in butter, squeeze lemon, season with dill.

recipes.name: Beef Stew
recipes.instructions: Brown beef, dredged in flour. Add vegetables, tomatoes, water. Simmer 90 min.

recipes.name: Crepes
recipes.instructions: Whisk batter thin. Pour into hot buttered pan, swirl, flip after 1 min.

recipes.name: Chicken Salad
recipes.instructions: Mix cooked shredded chicken with mayo, celery, grapes. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.name: Egg Drop Soup
recipes.instructions: Bring broth with ginger to boil. Thicken with cornstarch. Swirl in beaten egg, add soy sauce, top with scallion.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.instructions: Soak noodles. Stir-fry shrimp, garlic, push aside scramble egg. Add noodles, sprouts, sauce. Top with peanuts, lime.

recipes.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.instructions: Mix cooked rice, beef, onion, tomato. Stuff peppers, top with cheese, bake 40 min.

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Blend banana, eggs, oats. Cook on greased pan. Drizzle with honey.
